solace.jei.alchemist_cauldron.info: The Alchemist Cauldron can be used to brew potions. Put water inside, place a heat source underneath, and add ingredients to brew custom potions and elixirs.
item.solace.wooden_hammer.tooltip: Acts as both a wooden axe and a wooden pickaxe.
solace.jei.arcane_anvil.info: The Arcane Anvil now only combines an Infused Book with an Identified Artifact. Both inputs are consumed to create the artifact's corresponding Enchanted Book.
